Hello again, my friend! It is Ananse. Today we are going to take some away.
Look! Five mangoes are sitting here. Let us count them together.
One.
Two.
Three.
Four.
Five.
Five mangoes! Now watch what happens.
I am hungry. I will eat one mango.
Yum! One mango is gone.
I am still hungry. Here goes one more.
Two mangoes are gone. Can you see the empty spaces?
The mangoes I ate are not here any more. So we count the ones that are still here.
Three mangoes are left.
Five, take away two, leaves three.
Let us try again. Here are four mangoes.
Watch. I will eat two of them.
Now count what is left, starting at one.
Two mangoes are left. Four, take away two, leaves two.
Every time, we count the ones that are still here.
Now it is your turn! Count out the mangoes and feed them to Ananse.
